# Echo Your Influence

> Echo Your Influence turns any product, app store, or website URL into a full ad kit: multi-ratio ad images and device mockups plus a 15- or 30-second AI influencer-style video with voiceover, captions, and a tracked link — built for hands-off affiliate marketing on TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

Echo Your Influence is a SaaS app for affiliate marketers and creators. Users paste a product page, choose an AI persona, and receive a ready-to-post vertical MP4 plus a tracked short link. Plans: Starter Test Pass ($29.95/mo, 5 videos + 30 images), Pro Creator ($49/mo, 15 videos + 150 images), and Agency ($99/mo, 30 videos + 500 images). Referrers earn 2 months of credit for every friend who upgrades.
